rows.text: I have a premonition: Today is going to be the day I escape!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I'm going to witness history?
Don't waste your energy.
You're just like those narrow-minded prisoners, brushing me off and being sarcastic. Just you wait. I have been preparing for this for countless days and nights. Nothing can go wrong.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Just give up. The place is surrounded by aurumaton soldiers.
You don't believe that those bolt-brains could ever compete with my great mind, do you? Those aurumatons are simple and dim-witted. I figured out their patrol routes a long time ago!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Shiratori begins to flap his wings and...
Ow-ow-owww... I failed again? How? This is my 1,381st failure...
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Waaaa... I thought I had taken care of every problem! Where could I have gone wrong?
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Are you okay...?
Ahaha... Interesting! The Shackling Prison truly is fascinating. This is what a real prison should be like. It makes all those other prisons I've served time in look like open-air markets!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I have already ascertained where the problem was. I just need to slightly amend my approach... First I do this, then this, then this... I know I'll make it next time!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Looks like you're okay.
Why would I not be okay? I've never been better! Just knowing that I am in the process of cracking the most complex prison in the entire cosmos fills my whole body with fighting spirit!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Does no one care that you're so obviously trying to escape?
Those prison guards have seen everything. Sometimes I suspect they're deliberately leaving me to my own devices.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I'm not like those dangerous criminals who are always trying to destroy stuff to escape. I prefer to use my skills. My wings may make a lot of noise when I flap them, but they can't cause any real damage.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: What if it's a trap set by the Ten-Lords Commission?

I don't care if it's a trap. I'm happy as long as I have some mechanisms or puzzles to crack. I have to hand it to the Ten-Lords Commission, though. They really leave me scratching my head every time.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I'm a little tired now though. I'll get some rest before trying again.
rows.speaker: Shiratori
